talents.text: Your Mind Blast refreshes Shadow Word: Pain. Generates no threat. Applies Shadow Weaving at full stacks. Its cooldown resets on a killing blow. It consumes Shadow Word: Pain for burst.

talents.name: Improved Psychic Scream
talents.text: Psychic Scream's cooldown drops and it breaks on a smaller amount of damage. Against fear-immune targets it instead reduces their movement speed and damage dealt for its duration.

talents.name: Shadow Weaving
talents.text: Your direct Shadow spells leave the target vulnerable to Shadow. The vulnerability stacks twice. Your periodic Shadow damage also applies it. It stacks five times. Anyone's Shadow damage benefits.

talents.name: Mind Melt
talents.text: Your periodic shadow damage refreshes on Mind Flay. Your Mind Flay may be cast while moving. It does not break on damage. It applies Vampiric Embrace's healing. A full channel resets Mind Blast.

talents.name: Vampiric Embrace
talents.text: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 1 min.

talents.name: Improved Vampiric Embrace
talents.text: Vampiric Embrace returns more health. The returned health may exceed full and becomes a shield.

talents.name: Silence
talents.text: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec.

talents.name: Inner Light
talents.text: Your Renew benefits from your Shadow damage. Your heals extend Vampiric Embrace. Power Word: Shield does not break Shadowform.

talents.name: Void
talents.text: Your shadow damage is greatly increased and you may not be healed by anyone but yourself.

talents.name: Umbral Mirror
talents.text: Shadow Word: Pain refreshes when you cast Mind Blast and cannot be dispelled below 20% target health. If you can emit a Corona, its ticks carry one.

talents.name: Darkness
talents.text: Shadowform no longer prevents you from casting Power Word: Shield on yourself while below half health. The restriction is removed entirely. Being critically struck in Shadowform generates a stack of Shadow Weaving. Damage beyond a tenth of your health generates a stack. Any damage you take in Shadowform generates a stack.

talents.name: Shadowform
talents.text: Assume a Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 15% and reducing Physical damage done to you by 15%. However, you may not cast Holy spells while in this form.

talents.name: Remorseless Attacks
talents.text: Killing a target raises the critical strike chance of your next opener. The bonus holds through two openers.

talents.name: Improved Eviscerate
talents.text: Eviscerate refunds one combo point on a critical strike. It consumes any bleed on the target for additional damage. A killing blow with it refreshes Slice and Dice.

talents.name: Opportunity
talents.text: Your Ambush and Garrote deal increased damage. Cheap Shot gains the bonus. The bonus lasts 15 sec. Your first strikes of an encounter gain it as well. The bonus holds until you leave combat.

talents.name: Ruthlessness
talents.text: A finishing move that critically strikes returns a combo point. Every finishing move returns one. Your strikes lose no damage while you are moving.

talents.name: Improved Slice and Dice
talents.text: Your Slice and Dice refreshes rather than overwriting when reapplied. It persists 10 sec after leaving combat. It is not lost when you Vanish.

talents.name: Find Weakness
talents.text: Your finishers reduce the target's armor for 12 sec, stacking with Expose Armor rather than replacing it. The reduction applies to your whole party.

talents.name: Relentless Strikes
talents.text: Finishing moves restore energy, and every third strike you land sweeps through a second enemy.

talents.name: Puncturing Wounds
talents.text: A critical finisher applies a bleed scaling with combo points spent. The bleed cannot be dispelled. It spreads on the target's death. It ticks twice as fast below 20% health. Refreshing it carries remaining damage forward.

talents.name: Envenom
talents.text: Your poisons stack one higher than their maximum. They stack a second point higher. Eviscerate applies them. Every finishing move applies them. A finisher landed at full stacks refreshes their duration.

talents.name: Toxicology
talents.text: Your poisons deal increased damage. They stack one higher than their maximum. Eviscerate applies them. Every finishing move applies them. They cannot be cleansed.

talents.name: Cold Blood
talents.text: Your next strike is a guaranteed critical. Used on a finisher it doubles the combo points spent.

talents.name: Improved Kidney Shot
talents.text: A target you have Kidney Shot takes more damage from you. The effect lasts beyond the stun. It cannot be dispelled.

talents.name: Shadow Focus
talents.text: Your stealth abilities cost less energy while Slice and Dice is active. Premeditation feeds Seal Fate. Openers from stealth cannot be resisted.

talents.name: Blood Price
talents.text: Your finishers deal substantially more damage and cost health as well as energy.

talents.name: Blade Venom
talents.text: Your poisons apply from off-hand attacks at full rate. A finishing move spends a poison stack for immediate damage.

talents.name: Seal Fate
talents.text: Your critical strikes from abilities that add combo points add an additional one. The extra point is not lost on a miss. Two criticals in a row grant a third. Seal Fate triggers from poisons. A finisher spent at five points refreshes it.

talents.name: Master Poisoner
talents.text: Your poisons apply instantly at full stacks rather than building, and cannot be cleansed by any means. A target that dies while poisoned passes your stacks to the nearest enemy.

talents.name: Improved Gouge
talents.text: Gouge lasts longer and does not break on your periodic damage. It may be used from any angle. A target coming out of Gouge is slowed.

talents.name: Improved Sinister Strike
talents.text: Your Sinister Strike grants an additional combo point on a critical strike. It may be used from any angle without penalty.

talents.name: Opportunist
talents.text: Your Sinister Strike may be used from any angle. Sinister Strike refreshes your Slice and Dice. Your Backstab may be used from any angle. Your Ambush may be as well. Every strike from behind loses its positional requirement.

talents.name: Riposte
talents.text: A strike that becomes available after you parry, disarming the target briefly. It cannot be dodged and it refunds its energy on a critical strike.

talents.name: Bladework
talents.text: Parrying grants a combo point. Dodging does too. Avoidance refreshes Riposte. A parry refunds energy. Your Riposte cannot be avoided.

talents.name: Improved Backstab
talents.text: Your Backstab may be used from the side as well as from behind. Against a bleeding target it may be used from the front. It refreshes Rupture.

talents.name: Endurance
talents.text: Sprint and Evasion share no cooldown. Sprint removes movement-impairing effects. Evasion also reduces ranged damage taken. Both may be used while rooted.

talents.name: Improved Sprint
talents.text: Sprint removes movement-impairing effects on use. Against effects that cannot be removed it instead halves their remaining duration.

talents.name: Adrenaline
talents.text: Energy regeneration increases below 20 energy. A finisher refunds energy. Your Evasion grants energy. Energy caps higher during Blade Flurry. Abilities cost no energy for 3 sec after a killing blow. Your Sprint costs energy instead of a cooldown.

talents.name: Weapon Mastery
talents.text: Your equipped weapon determines the effect: swords grant a chance at an extra attack, maces stun, fists reduce the target's attack speed, and daggers allow Backstab from any angle. The effect also applies to your off-hand. It triggers from Blade Flurry. At full stacks it cannot be avoided. A killing blow refreshes it.

talents.name: Improved Kick
talents.text: Kick may silence what it interrupts. The silence lasts longer against a caster mid-cast.

talents.name: Vitality
talents.text: Your poisons persist through weapon swaps. They deal increased damage. They apply from Blade Flurry. They spread to everything it strikes. A poison application refreshes Slice and Dice.

talents.name: Blade Flurry
talents.text: Your attacks come faster and strike a second enemy beside your target. The extra strikes carry your poisons.

talents.name: Killing Spree
talents.text: Your Backstab and Ambush benefit from your off-hand weapon. Cheap Shot applies your Expose Armor. Openers refresh Slice and Dice.

talents.name: Cutthroat
talents.text: Your poisons benefit from your critical strike damage bonus. Eviscerate consumes poison stacks for damage rather than letting them fall off. Every finishing move does the same.

talents.name: Duellist
talents.text: You deal substantially more damage from the front and none at all from behind.

talents.name: Aggression
talents.text: Your finishing moves cost less energy. Below 10% target health they consume one fewer combo point. The threshold rises to 20%. A finisher that kills its target refunds a combo point. It refunds every combo point spent.

talents.name: Adrenaline Rush
talents.text: Your energy returns at double pace for a short time. Finishers used during it cost nothing.

talents.name: Master of Deception
talents.text: Stealth is harder to detect. It does not break on ambient damage. It may be entered in combat once every 3 min. The cooldown drops to 2 min. It drops to 1 min.

talents.name: Opportunity
talents.text: Your Ambush and Garrote deal increased damage. Cheap Shot gains the bonus. The bonus lasts 15 sec. Your first strikes of an encounter gain it as well. The bonus holds until you leave combat.

talents.name: Initiative
talents.text: Your Cheap Shot grants an additional combo point. Ambush and Garrote grant one as well. The effect works on a raid pull rather than only from stealth.

talents.name: Camouflage
talents.text: Stealth movement speed rises. It reaches your normal speed. Movement-impairing effects cannot slow you while stealthed. Your Sprint does not break stealth. Vanish resets it.

talents.name: Improved Sap
talents.text: Your Sap lasts longer. Against Sap-immune targets it instead reduces the damage they deal in melee. The reduction extends to all damage they deal.

talents.name: Ghostly Strike
talents.text: A strike that deals 125% weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

talents.name: Serrated Blades
talents.text: Eviscerate reduces the target's armor. Every finishing move reduces it. Eviscerate also applies a bleed. Every finisher applies the bleed. The bleed scales with combo points spent.

talents.name: Setup
talents.text: Avoiding an attack grants a combo point. Your Riposte does. A full dodge chain refreshes Evasion.

talents.name: Elusiveness
talents.text: Vanish and Blind cooldowns drop. Vanish removes damage over time effects.

talents.name: Hemorrhage
talents.text: A strike that marks the target, increasing your party's Physical damage against it. The mark stacks three times. It persists through your death. It transfers on target death.

talents.name: Preparation
talents.text: Your Rogue cooldowns are finished at once. Preparation does not finish its own.

talents.name: Deadened Nerves
talents.text: Your Ambush applies your active poison at full stacks. Backstab applies it as well. A poison applied from stealth strikes for its full duration at once. Your poisons deal increased damage and cannot be cleansed.

talents.name: Silent Death
talents.text: Your openers cannot be dodged or resisted. They generate no threat. You deal no damage from the front.

talents.name: Shadow Dance
talents.text: Your Blade Flurry does not break stealth openers. Your Ghostly Strike refreshes Slice and Dice.

talents.name: Fluid Guard
talents.text: Openers from stealth cannot be dodged and refresh Slice and Dice. If you build Momentum, an opener grants two stacks.

talents.name: Premeditation
talents.text: Grants combo points before an opener. They persist through a target change. They cannot be lost. Premeditation resets on a killing blow. It grants an extra finisher point.

talents.name: Shadowstrike
talents.text: A strike from stealth that does not break stealth, usable once per Vanish.

talents.name: Convection
talents.text: Critical strikes with Lightning Bolt restore mana. All your Nature criticals gain the refund. Your Nature spells deal increased damage for the first 10 sec of an encounter. The effect extends to all your spells. The window extends to 20 sec.

talents.name: Storm Reach
talents.text: Your Lightning spells reach further and chain further. Every third spell you cast strikes a second enemy.

talents.name: Elemental Warding
talents.text: Fire, Frost, and Nature damage taken is reduced. The reduction also applies to your totems. A resisted spell grants you a shield.

talents.name: Call of Flame
talents.text: Fire totems inherit your spell critical chance. Fire Nova arms instantly when an enemy enters its radius. Magma Totem pulses on a target that flees.

talents.name: Earth's Grasp
talents.text: Stoneclaw taunts on a delay instead of instantly. Earthbind slows casting as well as movement.

talents.name: Static Field
talents.text: Your Lightning Shield orbs are shared with your totems. Your totems struck discharge an orb. A discharged orb refreshes Flame Shock.

talents.name: Elemental Focus
talents.text: Casting an elemental spell may leave you Clearcast, so the next costs nothing. Clearcasting also removes its pushback.

talents.name: Reverberation
talents.text: Shocks no longer share a cooldown with each other. A Shock refreshes on a critical strike. Earth Shock interrupts through immunity. Your Frost Shock's slow applies to attack speed. A Shock cast during Clearcasting costs nothing and does not consume the proc.

talents.name: Storm Caller
talents.text: Your Lightning Bolt may be cast while moving at reduced damage. Your Chain Lightning cannot be resisted on its first target. A critical Lightning Bolt shortens Chain Lightning's cooldown. Overloads cannot draw threat. Chain Lightning bounces back to its origin.

talents.name: Elemental Devastation
talents.text: Your offensive spell criticals grant you melee critical strike chance. The effect stacks. It persists through a weapon swap.

talents.name: Eye of the Storm
talents.text: Being struck while casting may leave you unable to be interrupted for a time. Any strike triggers it. It also refunds the interrupted cast.

talents.name: Improved Fire Totems
talents.text: Fire Nova's delay is removed entirely. A Fire totem that dies detonates.

talents.name: Elemental Fury
talents.text: Your fire totems strike harder and their criticals hit for double. A totem that dies discharges its remaining damage.

talents.name: Stormstrike Affinity
talents.text: Your Flame and Frost Shock scale with your attack power as well as your spell damage. Your weapon imbue adds to your spell damage. Melee critical strikes grant Clearcasting.

talents.name: Tidal Mastery
talents.text: Your Chain Lightning's jump logic applies to Chain Heal. Healing a target grants them your next Lightning Shield discharge. Your clearcasting applies to your heals.

talents.name: Grounded
talents.text: Your spells cannot be resisted or interrupted. You may no longer critically strike with them.

talents.name: Lightning Mastery
talents.text: Your Lightning Bolt gains a chance to overload and cast a free second copy. Overloads can chain. They apply Flame Shock. Chain Lightning can overload. An overload refunds the original spell's mana.

talents.name: Elemental Mastery
talents.text: Your next elemental spell is a guaranteed critical and costs nothing. Its cooldown returns on a killing blow.

talents.name: Stormbringer
talents.text: Windfury can proc from an extra attack once per swing. Its proc rate stops scaling down with weapon speed. A proc refreshes your weapon imbue duration. Two procs in a row make your next Shock free. A proc grants a stack that increases the next one's damage.

talents.name: Totemic Focus
talents.text: Dropping a totem no longer resets your swing timer. Your totems inherit your weapon imbue's element. A totem destroyed by an enemy refunds its mana. You may drop two totems on one global cooldown. Your buff totems follow you within 20 yd.

talents.name: Elemental Cadence
talents.text: Earth Shock leaves the Flame and Frost Shock cooldown alone. A Shock within 3 sec of a Windfury proc costs no mana. Frost Shock also slows attack speed. Your Flame Shock spreads to a second target on your next proc. Shocks no longer clip your swing.

talents.name: Charged
talents.text: Lightning Shield orbs are consumed by your attacks as well as by being hit. Losing an orb refunds mana. At full orbs your next Shock chains to a second target.

talents.name: Guardian Totems
talents.text: Stoneskin also shortens movement-impairing effects. Windwall reflects one ranged attack every 10 sec.

talents.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
talents.text: Ghost Wolf is instant and may be entered in combat. It sheds movement-impairing effects on the shift.

talents.name: Weapon Mastery
talents.text: Your equipped weapon determines the effect: swords grant a chance at an extra attack, maces stun, fists reduce the target's attack speed, and daggers allow Backstab from any angle. The effect also applies to your off-hand. It triggers from Blade Flurry. At full stacks it cannot be avoided. A killing blow refreshes it.

talents.name: Enhancing Totems
talents.text: Strength of Earth and Grace of Air persist for 10 sec after leaving their radius. They scale with your weapon imbue. Recasting one does not clear its buff from anyone still in range.

talents.name: Static Charge
talents.text: Your critical strikes add an orb to Lightning Shield. Orbs beyond maximum become damage. Crits refresh your weapon imbue. At full orbs a crit discharges one at a nearby enemy. A crit within 3 sec of a Windfury proc grants another proc.

talents.name: Ancestral Guidance
talents.text: Healing Wave no longer stops your swing. Your Lesser Healing Wave may be cast while moving. Healing a target grants them your Lightning Shield's next discharge. Your heals generate no threat while a totem of yours is active. Overhealing becomes attack power for 6 sec.

talents.name: Elemental Weapons
talents.text: Your weapon imbues add spell damage as well as their own effect. Flame and Frost Shock scale with it. Lightning Bolt may be cast without stopping your swing.

talents.name: Improved Weapon Totems
talents.text: Your Windfury Totem also grants its attack power to you while you are within range of it. Its proc can trigger from an extra attack. Your Flametongue Totem applies your weapon imbue to the party. A totem you drop refreshes the imbue on everyone in range.

talents.name: Earthbound
talents.text: Your totems become immune to damage and last twice as long. You may have only one totem active at a time.

talents.name: Ancestral Strength
talents.text: Your Healing Wave may be cast without stopping your swing. A heal you cast refreshes your weapon imbue.

talents.name: Windfury Mastery
talents.text: Windfury's extra attacks use your main hand's full damage. They can critically strike. They generate no threat. They refresh Flame Shock. A proc during Stormstrike's window adds a third attack.

talents.name: Stormstrike
talents.text: Gives you an extra attack. In addition, the next 2 sources of Nature damage dealt to the target are increased by 20%. Lasts 12 sec.

talents.name: Tidal Focus
talents.text: A Healing Wave that overheals refunds mana. All your heals gain the refund. The overhealed portion of a critical heal chains to a second target. Any overheal chains. It banks toward your next cast.

talents.name: Ancestral Healing
talents.text: Your heal grants armor. It reduces damage taken as well. It applies to everyone the heal touched. It persists 10 sec after the heal. It cannot be dispelled.

talents.name: Improved Reincarnation
talents.text: Reincarnation's cooldown drops. You return with full mana as well as health.

talents.name: Chain Mastery
talents.text: Chain Heal jumps further. Prefers the lowest-health target. Does not lose effect per jump against targets below 30%. Can bounce back to its origin. Jumps to a target with no heal-over-time first.

talents.name: Healing Focus
talents.text: Your Healing Wave may resist interruption from damage. Lesser Healing Wave and Chain Heal gain the effect. All your healing spells gain it. They resist it entirely while you are below one quarter health. The threshold rises to half your health.

talents.name: Totemic Mastery
talents.text: The radius of your totems that affect friendly targets is increased to 30 yd.

talents.name: Totemic Reach
talents.text: Your totems reach twice as far. They follow you between them. A totem out of range still counts as placed.

talents.name: Healing Grace
talents.text: Healing generates less threat. Threat you do generate transfers to the target after 6 sec. Overhealing generates none at all.

talents.name: Restorative Totems
talents.text: Mana Spring and Healing Stream Totem reach your whole raid. They persist 10 sec after being destroyed. They cannot be targeted by enemies. They scale with your healing bonus. Dropping one refreshes the other.

talents.name: Tidal Mastery
talents.text: A critical Healing Wave chains to a second ally at one third value. The chain seeks an injured ally. The effect extends to your other heals. The chain's value rises to half. The chain cannot overheal.

talents.name: Nature's Swiftness
talents.text: Your next Nature spell is instant. It may be used while silenced, and using it does not break your own crowd control.

talents.name: Healing Way
talents.text: Healing Wave leaves the target more receptive to your next. The effect stacks. It does not fall off between fights.

talents.name: Elemental Communion
talents.text: Your Lightning Shield discharges heal instead of damage while Healing Stream Totem is active. Any healing totem maintains the effect. Your Chain Lightning uses Chain Heal's jump logic.

talents.name: Ancestor's Vigil
talents.text: Your totems heal continuously and cannot be destroyed. You may not cast direct heals.

talents.name: Stoneskin Discipline
talents.text: Your Earth Shield-style effects persist through your own melee damage. Healing a target grants them a portion of your weapon imbue's effect.

talents.name: Conduit's Grace
talents.text: Chain Heal's jumps prefer the lowest-health ally and cannot overheal. If you can empower, Chain Heal may be empowered for an extra jump per stage.

talents.name: Purification
talents.text: Cleansing a poison heals the target. Cleansing a disease does as well. Your Cure Poison removes one additional effect. Cure Disease removes one additional effect. They share no cooldown.

talents.name: Mana Tide Totem
talents.text: A totem that returns mana to your party over its life. It restores more as its own health falls, and it cannot be attacked below half.

talents.name: Suppression
talents.text: Your damage-over-time effects cannot be dispelled. They cannot be resisted on application. They do not break on damage. They persist through your death. They spread to a nearby enemy when their target dies.

talents.name: Improved Corruption
talents.text: Your Corruption applies instantly at rank 1. Refreshes on your Shadow Bolt. Ticks faster below 20%. Spreads on death. Carries remaining damage forward when refreshed.

talents.name: Improved Drain Soul
talents.text: Drain Soul restores mana while it channels. It restores more on a killing blow, and the mana persists through death.

talents.name: Siphon
talents.text: Drain Life and Drain Mana channel while you move. They do not break on damage. They benefit from your shadow damage. They apply Corruption. They refund a shard on a killing blow.

talents.name: Curse Mastery
talents.text: Two curses may be active at once. Curses cannot be dispelled. A curse refreshes on your damage-over-time ticks. Amplify Curse has no cooldown. Curses apply to everything Corruption is on.

talents.name: Fel Concentration
talents.text: Your channelled spells cannot be interrupted by damage. Pushback is capped at once per channel. A channel completed under fire grants a soul shard. Interruption refunds the mana spent. You may channel while silenced once every 45 sec.

talents.name: Amplify Curse
talents.text: Your next Curse lands at doubled strength and cannot be dispelled. Amplifying a Curse of Agony makes it tick from the first second.

talents.name: Grim Reach
talents.text: Your Affliction effects gain range. Reapplying one at maximum range does not break your current cast. Your curses reach as far as your damage-over-time effects.

talents.name: Nightfall
talents.text: Corruption and Drain Life may make your next Shadow Bolt instant. Nightfall also refunds its mana.

talents.name: Improved Drain Mana
talents.text: The mana your Drain Mana takes also burns the target. It burns harder against a target already out of mana.

talents.name: Shadow Embrace
talents.text: Your periodic effects make a target vulnerable to Shadow, and the vulnerability stacks. While Dark Pact holds, your periodics also afflict one nearby enemy.

talents.name: Siphon Life
talents.text: Transfers 15 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

talents.name: Soul Siphon
talents.text: Your Shadow Bolt refreshes Corruption. Your Immolate benefits from your shadow damage. Conflagrate does not consume Immolate on a target affected by Corruption.

talents.name: Malediction
talents.text: Your Curses last longer and cannot be dispelled. They afflict one nearby enemy as well.

talents.name: Unstable Affliction
talents.text: Your damage-over-time effects deal substantially more damage and detonate when dispelled. You may no longer cast Shadow Bolt.

talents.name: Shadow Mastery
talents.text: Your Shadow spells ignore a portion of the target's resistance. They cannot be reflected. Shadow damage over time ticks faster below 20% target health. Your Shadow spells apply Curse of Shadow's vulnerability. A Shadow critical refreshes Corruption.

talents.name: Dark Pact
talents.text: Your demon's life becomes yours to spend. Consuming it restores your health and mana in full and leaves your Shadow damage raised for the rest of the encounter. For 20 sec your Shadow spells cost nothing and strike a second enemy. You may not summon another demon.

talents.name: Bound Servant
talents.text: Your demon inherits your resistances. It inherits your armor as well. A demon that dies returns after 1 min at 30% health. The wait shortens to 30 sec. Summoning costs no shard.

talents.name: Familiar
talents.text: Your Imp's Firebolt applies Corruption. Your Voidwalker's Torment scales with your spell power. Your demon's attacks benefit from your own hit chance.

talents.name: Soulcraft
talents.text: Healthstones can be used while silenced. Creating one below 30% health costs no shard.

talents.name: Soul Tether
talents.text: Health Funnel channels while you cast. Your demon's damage returns health to you. A demon at full health funnels back to you instead. Your Health Funnel on a full demon becomes damage against its target. Your demon's regeneration applies to you while it is idle.

talents.name: Demonic Resilience
talents.text: Your demon takes reduced damage from area effects. It cannot be feared. When it attacks, it breaks roots on you.

talents.name: Guardian
talents.text: Voidwalker's Sacrifice absorbs based on your health rather than the Voidwalker's. Consuming Shadows can be cast on you.

talents.name: Fel Domination
talents.text: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its mana cost reduced by 50%.

talents.name: Swift Binding
talents.text: Fel Domination's cooldown drops. It applies to Enslave Demon. A demon summoned under it arrives at full health. Swapping demons carries your active buffs across. Fel Domination holds two charges.

talents.name: Cruelty
talents.text: Succubus's Lash of Pain reduces healing received. Felhunter's Spell Lock silences longer against a target mid-cast. Imp's Fire Shield reflects to a second attacker.

talents.name: Master Summoner
talents.text: Summoning is instant if your previous demon died within 10 sec. Summoning does not break your current cast.

talents.name: Demonic Empowerment
talents.text: Your Imp gains a command you can trigger. It becomes a charge you spend. The Voidwalker gains one and taunts. The Succubus gains one and breaks a caster. The Felhunter gains one and drains.

talents.name: Demonic Sacrifice
talents.text: Sacrificing your demon grants you an effect that holds for the rest of the encounter, shaped by which demon you spent. Summoning another ends it.

talents.name: Shadow Bond
talents.text: Your demon's damage benefits from your curses. Your Corruption refreshes on any target your demon damages. Your demon's critical strikes extend Siphon Life.

talents.name: Ashen Pact
talents.text: Your demon's attacks apply your Immolate's fire damage. Your Conflagrate does not consume Immolate while your demon is on the target. Searing Pain from you draws no threat if your demon is attacking.

talents.name: Unbound
talents.text: You may have two demons active at once. Neither may be sacrificed, and both answer your commands.

talents.name: Master Demonologist
talents.text: Your demon grows stronger the longer it stands beside you. The bonus builds twice as fast. It persists through your demon's death. Your demon's threat is reduced. It draws no threat of its own.

talents.name: Soul Link
talents.text: Links you with your demon so that 30% of damage dealt to you is instead taken by it. Lasts as long as your demon lives and persists through your death.

talents.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
talents.text: Your Shadow Bolt applies a vulnerability consumed by the next attacker. The vulnerability stacks. It does not expire. It applies on cast rather than on hit. It spreads on death.

talents.name: Aftermath
talents.text: Your Destruction spells may daze the target. A dazed target casts more slowly. Your Rain of Fire applies Immolate's burn at reduced value. Your direct Fire spells do as well. Every Destruction spell applies it.

talents.name: Improved Immolate
talents.text: Immolate's direct half scales with its remaining periodic damage. It refreshes on Shadow Bolt. It cannot be dispelled. It ticks faster below 20% health. It detonates on expiry.

talents.name: Intensity
talents.text: Your Destruction spells cannot be pushed back. A spell that would have been pushed back instead finishes early.

talents.name: Destructive Reach
talents.text: Range increases. Your threat is reduced. Rain of Fire follows a marked target.

talents.name: Shadowburn
talents.text: Instantly blasts the target for 91 to 104 Shadow damage. If the target dies within 5 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

talents.name: Improved Searing Pain
talents.text: Searing Pain draws no threat. It consumes Immolate for burst. It applies Immolate. It refreshes Conflagrate. Two casts in a row are free.

talents.name: Pyroclasm
talents.text: Your Fire spells may stun. For the first 20 sec of an encounter they deal increased damage.

talents.name: Devastation
talents.text: A critical Destruction spell refreshes Immolate on its target. It grants a soul shard. It applies Aftermath. It cannot be resisted. Two in a row make your next Destruction spell instant.

talents.name: Emberstorm
talents.text: Your direct Fire spells consume Immolate stacks for damage. Your Rain of Fire applies Immolate. Every Fire spell you cast consumes stacks. Your Hellfire does not damage you while Immolate is active.

talents.name: Ruin
talents.text: Your Destruction criticals strike for double rather than half again. A critical that kills refunds its shard.

talents.name: Cataclysm
talents.text: Your Immolate counts as a curse. Your Corruption refreshes it. Curse of Agony benefits from your fire damage.

talents.name: Nether Protection
talents.text: Your demon's attacks apply Immolate. Soul Link shares your fire damage bonus.

talents.name: Backdraft
talents.text: Conflagrate loses its cooldown. You may no longer cast Shadow Bolt.

talents.name: Fel Kindling
talents.text: Conflagrate no longer consumes Immolate and extends its duration instead. If you carry fel corruption, Conflagrate spends a stack for double damage.

talents.name: Conflagrate
talents.text: Conflagrate no longer consumes Immolate. It extends it. It hits a second target. It cannot be resisted. It resets on a killing blow.

talents.name: Shadow and Flame
talents.text: Immolate empowers your Shadow Bolts while it burns, and each Shadow Bolt extends it. A Shadow Bolt cast into your own Immolate cannot be resisted, and Immolate's remaining damage is added to the killing blow.

talents.name: Bloodletting
talents.text: Critical strikes cause bleeding. The bleed does not fall off early. A bleeding target takes every third blow as though it were two enemies.

talents.name: Poise
talents.text: Dodged and parried attacks refund their Rage. Overpower's cooldown resets on a dodge. You cannot be disarmed in Battle Stance. Hamstring's slow cannot be dispelled. Your rage does not decay while a target you struck recently is still alive.

talents.name: Concussion
talents.text: Thunder Clap also slows casting. It spreads Rend to targets already bleeding. It becomes usable in any stance.

talents.name: Headlong
talents.text: Charge usable in combat when no enemy is within 8 yd. Charge interrupts spellcasting.

talents.name: Tactical Mastery
talents.text: Swapping to Battle Stance retains your Rage. Swapping to Berserker Stance retains it. Swapping to Defensive Stance retains it. Stance swapping has no cooldown. Swapping stances reopens Overpower's window.

talents.name: Riposte Reading
talents.text: Your Overpower cannot be dodged or parried. Overpower's window opens on any miss rather than only a dodge.

talents.name: Deep Wounds
talents.text: Your critical strikes cause bleeding. Refreshing carries remaining damage forward rather than overwriting. The bleed jumps to a nearby enemy on death.

talents.name: Battle Trance
talents.text: Three consecutive attacks without a miss makes your next Overpower or Execute free.

talents.name: Sweeping Strikes
talents.text: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

talents.name: Weapon Mastery
talents.text: The effect follows your equipped weapon, and swords grant a chance at an extra attack. Maces stun the target. Fists reduce the target's attack speed. Daggers allow Backstab from any angle. The effect extends to your off-hand and to Blade Flurry, cannot be avoided at full stacks, and a killing blow refreshes it.

talents.name: Opportunist
talents.text: Sweeping Strikes copies your Overpower, and the copies wound as the original does. Your strikes from behind may be used from any angle.

talents.name: Rupture Line
talents.text: Your Execute refreshes your bleeds. Your bleeds on a target below 20% tick twice as fast. A target dying while bleeding refunds the Rage spent on Execute.

talents.name: Mortal Cleave
talents.text: Your Cleave and Whirlwind apply Mortal Strike's healing reduction. The reduction persists for 4 sec after the target leaves your melee range.

talents.name: Sure Strike
talents.text: Your melee attacks can no longer be dodged, parried, or miss. Your melee attacks can no longer critically strike.

talents.name: Second Wind
talents.text: Your being stunned or rooted generates Rage. The second rank breaks the effect once per 30 sec.

talents.name: Guarded Stance
talents.text: Your Overpower may be used in Defensive Stance. Your Sunder Armor applies from Mortal Strike.

talents.name: Crippling Grip
talents.text: Your Hamstring roots rather than slows. The root holds through your own damage. Every third strike you land while a target is rooted sweeps through two enemies beside it.

talents.name: Death Sentence
talents.text: Execute refunds its Rage on a kill. Usable below 35% against targets you have Rent. A kill by Execute resets Overpower.

talents.name: Unyielding
talents.text: Reduces the duration of stuns used against you. Reduces the duration of disarms. You continue attacking for 2 sec after a fear begins.

talents.name: Mortal Strike
talents.text: A vicious strike that wounds, halving the healing its target receives. While the wound holds, every third strike you land sweeps through two nearby enemies and carries the wound with it. A wounded target that dies passes the wound to the nearest enemy.

talents.name: Booming Voice
talents.text: Shouts affect the raid. Persist through death. Refresh on a killing blow. Cost no rage below 20 rage. Apply to targets instead of allies as a debuff.

talents.name: Bloodletting
talents.text: Your critical strikes cause bleeding. The bleed does not fall off early. A bleeding target takes each fifth blow as though it were two enemies. The interval tightens to each fourth blow. It tightens to every third.

talents.name: Unbridled Wrath
talents.text: Your strikes generate rage more freely. A critical strike generates it twice. You generate rage faster still for the first 10 sec of an encounter. The window extends to 15 sec. It extends to 20 sec.

talents.name: Improved Demoralizing Shout
talents.text: Demoralizing Shout also reduces the target's critical strike chance. It applies to targets behind you. It cannot be dispelled. It refreshes when a target you have shouted at strikes you. A target that resists it is slowed instead.

talents.name: Blood Craze
talents.text: Being critically struck regenerates health over 6 sec. The regeneration cannot be interrupted. It also triggers on a block.

talents.name: Piercing Howl
talents.text: A howl that dazes everything near you. It cannot be resisted, and a dazed target cannot mount.

talents.name: Improved Cleave
talents.text: Your Cleave hits a third target. Applies your last special attack's effect. Costs no rage while enraged.

talents.name: Rampage
talents.text: A killing blow grants attack speed. The effect stacks. It persists 10 sec out of combat. It triggers on a critical strike. It carries across targets.

talents.name: Enrage
talents.text: While enraged your Heroic Strike costs no rage. Your shouts cost none. All your abilities cost none. Being enraged prevents fear. Taking a critical hit refreshes its duration.

talents.name: Dual Wield Specialization
talents.text: While enraged your off-hand strikes for its full weight rather than half. It strikes for its full weight at all times. Two one-handers strike faster together than either alone. A critical strike with your main hand readies your off-hand. A critical strike with either hand readies the other.

talents.name: Improved Execute
talents.text: Execute costs less rage. It costs none against a target below 10% health.

talents.name: Death Wish
talents.text: You deal more damage and take more, and cannot be feared. It may be used while feared and while enraged, and it does not break your own crowd control.

talents.name: Improved Intercept
talents.text: Intercept's cooldown drops and it may be used in any stance. It removes movement-impairing effects on arrival.

talents.name: Sundering Blows
talents.text: Your Sunder Armor applies from Cleave. It also applies from Whirlwind. Your Overpower benefits from your off-hand. Shield Slam may be used without a shield at reduced effect.

talents.name: Reckless
talents.text: Your critical strike chance is greatly increased. You cannot dodge, parry, or block.

talents.name: Shieldbreaker
talents.text: Your Cleave and Whirlwind ignore a portion of block value. Bloodthirst heals for more against a target you are tanking.

talents.name: Improved Berserker Rage
talents.text: Berserker Rage generates rage on use and cannot be prevented. For the first 20 sec of an encounter your strikes deal increased damage.

talents.name: Flurry
talents.text: A critical strike hastens your next swings. The effect does not fall off on a miss. It also hastens your shout casts. It stacks to two applications. While active your attacks cannot be dodged.

talents.name: Bloodthirst
talents.text: An instant strike that draws blood. Each of your next five melee hits returns health, and against a bleeding target the strike hits everything in front of you.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
talents.text: Blocking generates rage. Refreshes Shield Block. A block grants a stacking damage reduction. Blocked damage generates threat. Two blocks in a row reset Revenge.

talents.name: Anticipation
talents.text: A dodge refreshes Revenge. A parry does as well. A dodge grants rage. A parry grants it too. Reduces Shield Slam's cooldown.

talents.name: Improved Bloodrage
talents.text: Your Bloodrage generates threat. It may be used while stunned.

talents.name: Toughness
talents.text: Damage you take refreshes Battle Shout. It refreshes Demoralizing Shout as well. It refreshes any active shout. It generates threat. Reduces the next hit.

talents.name: Iron Will
talents.text: The duration of stuns against you is reduced. The duration of charms is reduced. A stun from an immune source instead generates rage. A charm from an immune source does as well. The rage granted is doubled.

talents.name: Last Stand
talents.text: You gain a share of your maximum health for 20 sec. When it ends the health drains away rather than vanishing.

talents.name: Improved Shield Block
talents.text: Shield Block covers an additional attack. It may be used while stunned. It refreshes on a parry.

talents.name: Improved Revenge
talents.text: Revenge stuns the target. Against stun-immune targets it instead reduces their damage dealt. Revenge may be used without having blocked, dodged, or parried.

talents.name: Defiance
talents.text: Your threat decays more slowly while you hold aggro. It does not decay at all. It holds against everything in melee range. A share of it transfers on Taunt. Taunt transfers it in full.

talents.name: Improved Sunder Armor
talents.text: Your Sunder Armor costs less rage. Applies from Cleave. Does not fall off while you are in melee range.

talents.name: Improved Disarm
talents.text: Your Disarm lasts longer. Against disarm-immune targets it instead reduces their damage. The reduction matches a full disarm.

talents.name: Improved Taunt
talents.text: Taunt's cooldown drops. Taunt works on an already-taunted target.

talents.name: Concussion Blow
talents.text: A blow that stuns. It cannot be resisted, and a stunned target takes your next strike as a critical.

talents.name: Sword and Board
talents.text: Your Overpower may be used with a shield equipped. Your Deep Wounds applies from Shield Slam. Mortal Strike's healing reduction applies from Revenge.

talents.name: Bulwark
talents.text: Your Cleave generates block value. Your Whirlwind does as well. Bloodthirst heals for your block value.

talents.name: Unbreakable
talents.text: You cannot be critically struck. You can no longer critically strike.

talents.name: Rimeguard
talents.text: Shield Block absorbs an additional attack and refreshes on a parry. If your weapon holds charges, blocking grants one.

talents.name: Shield Discipline
talents.text: Your Shield Slam refreshes Shield Block. It dispels one magic effect. It applies Sunder Armor. It cannot miss. It resets Last Stand below 20% health.

talents.name: Shield Slam
talents.text: Slam the target with your shield, causing 225 to 236 damage, modified by your Shield Block value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Also causes a high amount of threat.

talents.name: Bastion
talents.text: Your Shield Slam cannot be dodged or parried and draws far more attention than its damage warrants. Blocking an attack readies it at once.

mechanic.name: Blight
mechanic.description: Blight, a disease applied by Blackguard strikes that roughly a third of the tree pays out against

lore.verbNote: The only tree that should be done to the character rather than by them. A paladin does not apply to become a death knight.
lore.permanentCost: Loses the ability to cast Blessings or direct heals on other players.
lore.loreAnchor: Arthas was a paladin. The Death Knight fantasy is the paladin fantasy corrupted, and Warcraft III spends an entire campaign on the transition.

talents.name: Unholy Vigor
talents.text: Your melee strikes apply Blight. Blight applied this way stacks twice. It cannot be dispelled. It spreads to a nearby enemy on death. A target at full Blight takes double damage from your next strike.

talents.name: Grave Cold
talents.text: Your Blackguard abilities cost health instead of mana while a target near you carries Blight. Spending health this way applies a stack. Below 30% health they cost nothing.

talents.name: Deathward
talents.text: Shadow damage taken is reduced. Frost damage taken is also reduced. Absorbed damage returns as a shield. The shield discharges as Shadow damage on your next strike. A fully absorbed spell prevents a killing blow once every 3 min.

talents.name: Plague Strike
talents.text: Instant melee strike dealing weapon damage and applying Blight for 15 sec. The tree's enabler.

talents.name: Deathchill
talents.text: Your strikes chill what they touch and the chill deepens with each blow. A chilled target cannot escape you.

talents.name: Rotting Flesh
talents.text: Your Blight reduces the target's armor. It stacks with Sunder Armor rather than replacing it. At full stacks the reduction applies to your party.

talents.name: Morbid Strength
talents.text: Your attack power scales with Blight stacks on your current target. The scaling persists 6 sec after the target dies. It carries to your next target. Blight you did not apply also counts. At full stacks your strikes cannot be parried.

talents.name: Leeching Blade
talents.text: Your strikes against a Blighted target heal you. The healing scales with stacks held. Healing beyond full becomes a shield. The shield discharges as Shadow damage on your next strike. A killing blow on a Blighted target heals your party.

talents.name: Spreading Corruption
talents.text: Your Blight spreads to a nearby enemy on its own and spreads faster at full stacks. A target that dies passes every stack to whatever is closest.

talents.name: Chilblain
talents.text: Your Blight slows attack speed. It cannot be dispelled below 20% target health. It spreads on death.

talents.name: Presence of the Grave
talents.text: An aura that reduces damage taken and generates threat on everything nearby. Enemies striking you while it is active are slowed.

talents.name: Chill of the Grave
talents.text: Blight reduces healing received by its target. The reduction cannot be dispelled. At full stacks the target cannot be healed above 50%.

talents.name: Necrotic Aura
talents.text: Enemies within 8 yd take Shadow damage every 3 sec. The damage applies Blight. Enemies killed by it rise as a servant for 20 sec.

talents.name: Vile Contagion
talents.text: Blight no longer expires while its target is in combat. Blight spreads to everything within 8 yd when its target dies.

talents.name: Blood Rite
talents.text: Your next strike heals you for the damage it deals, cannot be avoided, and spends every Blight stack on the target as immediate damage. Healing beyond full is added to the strike.

talents.name: Unyielding Dead
talents.text: You cannot be critically struck by an enemy you have struck in the last 3 sec. The window extends to 6 sec. Surviving a killing blow once every 3 min heals you for the damage prevented.

talents.name: Corpsefeeder
talents.text: Blood Rite also removes one poison or disease from you. Its overhealing is added to your next strike.

talents.name: Damnation
talents.text: Your Blight never expires and cannot be dispelled, and every point of healing you would receive is converted into damage on your next strike. You may no longer be healed by another player.

talents.name: Frozen Heart
talents.text: Presence of the Grave converts damage taken into Blight on your attackers. It cannot be dispelled while you are below 50% health. Leaving it applies its accumulated Blight to everything nearby.

talents.name: Reaping
talents.text: Killing a Blighted enemy grants attack speed. Your strikes below 20% target health spend Blight for damage.

talents.name: Death's Advance
talents.text: You cannot be slowed below base speed while in combat. Closing to melee removes one movement-impairing effect every 10 sec. Snares on you are shortened.

talents.name: Damnation
talents.text: Your Blight never expires and cannot be dispelled, and every point of healing you would receive is converted into damage on your next strike. You may no longer be healed by another player.

mechanic.name: Risen
mechanic.description: The Risen, skeletal minions raised from corpses, plural and expiring

lore.verbNote: Necromancy in Warcraft is explicitly curriculum. Somebody teaches it, in a building, to students.
lore.loreAnchor: Kel'Thuzad was a Dalaran mage and a member of the Kirin Tor before founding the Cult of the Damned. Both endpoints of that career change are already in the game.

talents.name: Shadow Focus
talents.text: Your Necromancy spells cannot be partially resisted. A full resist raises one Risen. Your Risen cannot be resisted. Resisted spells refund their mana. A resist grants your next spell a free cast.

talents.name: Grave Robbing
talents.text: Your Necromancy spells cost health instead of mana while a Risen is active. Spending health this way heals your Risen. A Risen dying refunds the health spent.

talents.name: Deathchill Focus
talents.text: Your Risen inherit your resistances. They cannot be dispelled. They persist through your death. They rise at full strength rather than building. A Risen that dies raises another once per fight.

talents.name: Wither
talents.text: A shadow damage over time effect. Mage's first real DoT and the tree's rhythm-setter.

talents.name: Bone Chill
talents.text: Your Frost spells slow what they touch and the slow deepens with each application. It cannot be dispelled.

talents.name: Rotting Touch
talents.text: Your Risen strike hardest when newly raised. For the first 20 sec after you enter combat your Shadow damage and your Risen's damage are increased, and the bonus does not fall off early if a Risen dies. Raising a Risen outside combat starts the window on the pull.

talents.name: Dark Intellect
talents.text: Your spell damage scales with the number of Risen you control. A Risen consumed by Death Pact returns the scaling for 12 sec. Risen raised from a killing blow count double. The scaling persists 6 sec after all Risen die. At full Risen your spells cannot be interrupted.

talents.name: Siphon Life
talents.text: Wither heals you for a portion of its damage. All your Shadow damage over time heals you. The healing doubles below 10% of your own health. The threshold rises to 20%. It also heals your Risen.

talents.name: Corpse Harvest
talents.text: Your Risen accumulate on you rather than on the field. They persist through a target's death, between pulls, and out of combat, and you may hold up to three.

talents.name: Sepulchral Study
talents.text: Your summoning spells are instant. They may be cast before combat. A Risen dying refreshes the cooldown.

talents.name: Bone Armor
talents.text: Surrounds you with bone fragments absorbing damage. Each absorb consumes a fragment, so the shield visibly depletes.

talents.name: Contagion
talents.text: Your damage over time effects cannot be dispelled. They spread to a nearby enemy on death. They tick faster below 20% target health.

talents.name: Boneyard
talents.text: Raise every Risen you can hold at once, on a 3 min cooldown. They rise immediately and at full strength. The cooldown falls to 2 min.

talents.name: Withering Cold
talents.text: Your Frost spells apply decay and the decay stacks. At full stacks the target takes your Shadow damage as Frost.

talents.name: Raise Skeleton
talents.text: Consumes a corpse to raise a skeletal minion for 60 sec. One at a time.

talents.name: Grave Chill
talents.text: Bone Armor reduces the attack speed of melee attackers. It applies Blight to them. It cannot be stripped by their attacks.

talents.name: Necrotic Aptitude
talents.text: Your Risen do not expire while in combat. A Risen at expiry detonates for Shadow damage rather than vanishing.

talents.name: Grave Bargain
talents.text: Your Risen are permanent and rise at full strength. You may no longer cast any spell that does not raise or command them.

talents.name: Unstable Dead
talents.text: Your Risen explode on expiry, dealing damage scaled to how long they were held, and the explosion applies decay. A Risen killed by an enemy explodes for double. You may detonate them yourself.

talents.name: Dark Command
talents.text: Your pet and any summoned servant attack the target you last damaged without command. They inherit your critical strike chance.

talents.name: Death Pact
talents.text: Consuming a Risen heals you. Its remaining duration is added to your next spell as damage. It also removes one harmful effect.

talents.name: Command the Damned
talents.text: Your Risen no longer expire and answer from anywhere. They strike alongside you while you move, and every fifth strike they land sweeps through a second enemy.

mechanic.name: Corruption
mechanic.description: Fel corruption, a self-applied stacking state, plus the form itself at the bottom

lore.verbNote: Nobody grants this and nobody teaches it. The warlock performs a ritual on themselves and it works or it does not.
lore.permanentCost: Marked by the fel in a visible, permanent, mechanically minor way.
lore.loreAnchor: Metamorphosis is adapted from the Warcraft III Demon Hunter ability, visually based on Illidan, and was removed from warlocks in patch 7.0.3 specifically to make room for the Demon Hunter class.

talents.name: Fel Vigor
talents.text: Your Fire and Shadow damage applies fel Corruption. Corruption applied this way stacks twice. It does not decay in combat. It spreads on the target's death. At full stacks your next spell cannot be resisted.

talents.name: Demonic Hide
talents.text: Your armor scales with Corruption stacks held. The scaling persists through form changes. Corruption on you converts physical damage to Fire once per fight.

talents.name: Fel Concentration
talents.text: Your channelled spells cannot be interrupted by damage. Pushback is capped at once per channel. A channel completed while corrupted grants two stacks. Interruption converts to Corruption instead. You may channel while in the form.

talents.name: Shadow Cleave
talents.text: A short-range shadow attack striking up to three enemies in front of you. Works out of form, better in it.

talents.name: Fel Stamina
talents.text: Your maximum health scales with Corruption stacks held. Corruption spent on an ability heals you for a portion.

talents.name: Cruel Intent
talents.text: Shadow Cleave applies two stacks of Corruption. It strikes behind you. It spends stacks for damage.

talents.name: Demonic Bulwark
talents.text: Blocking applies Corruption to the attacker. Corruption on an attacker raises your block value. A full block spends its Corruption for damage. Blocking while at full Corruption refreshes Fel Aegis. You may block while in the form.

talents.name: Demonic Aegis
talents.text: Corruption stacks reduce physical damage taken. They convert magic damage to Fel. At full stacks they absorb a killing blow once per fight. Absorbed damage feeds the form. Breaking the absorb applies Corruption to everything nearby.

talents.name: Soul Link
talents.text: A portion of damage taken is redirected to your demon. The redirected share doubles.

talents.name: Master Summoner
talents.text: Summoning is instant while Corruption is on you. Summoning does not break your current cast. A demon summoned at full Corruption arrives enraged.

talents.name: Immolation Aura
talents.text: Deals periodic fire damage to nearby enemies and generates threat.

talents.name: Fel Resilience
talents.text: Stun and snare durations on you are reduced. You cannot be feared while in the form. Control effects that would be resisted are shortened instead.

talents.name: Unholy Sacrifice
talents.text: Sacrificing your demon grants Corruption stacks equal to its remaining health. The stacks arrive immediately and at full value. They do not decay.

talents.name: Fel Ferocity
talents.text: Corruption stacks raise Shadow Cleave's critical strike chance. A critical Shadow Cleave applies two stacks.

talents.name: Fel Aegis
talents.text: Partial transformation for 20 sec on a 3 min cooldown. Large armor bonus, increased threat, cheaper Shadow Cleave. Used before the pull it opens the fight at full fury, and for the first twenty seconds of an encounter your Shadow damage is increased.

talents.name: Demonic Knowledge
talents.text: Your spell damage scales with Corruption stacks held. Corruption on your demon counts toward the scaling. Spending Corruption grants the scaling for 12 sec regardless.

talents.name: Warding Fel
talents.text: Magic damage taken is reduced. Absorbing magic damage lengthens the caster's next cast.

talents.name: Irreversible
talents.text: Your Corruption stacks never decay and the form's bonuses double. You may no longer leave the form or summon a demon.

talents.name: Unending Fel
talents.text: Fel Aegis has no cooldown while you are at full Corruption. Using it spends all stacks and deals their value as Shadow damage. The damage strikes every enemy around you.

talents.name: Demonic Fury
talents.text: Your Shadow Cleave draws attention well beyond its damage. The attention holds through your demon's death.

talents.name: Fel Domination
talents.text: Summoning is instant and costs no shard. It may be used while in the form. The summoned demon arrives with your Corruption stacks.

talents.name: Metamorphosis
talents.text: Permanent demon form. Armor multiplied substantially, Shadow Bolt replaced by Shadow Cleave, all threat multiplied. Your Shadow spells may be cast while moving at reduced damage. You look like this now.

mechanic.name: Momentum
mechanic.description: Momentum, a stacking state gained by moving and by striking new targets, lost by standing still. Combo points remain the spend.

lore.verbNote: The rogue watches someone fight and learns it by imitation. The least mystical acquisition on the list and the most in character.
lore.loreAnchor: The Blademaster and the Aldrachi glaive tradition are both available as naming material without importing the Illidari. The Pandaren Brewmaster was a hireable Warcraft III neutral hero, not a race requirement.

talents.name: Flowing Form
talents.text: Your fist and unarmed strikes build Momentum. Momentum built this way does not decay while moving. Strikes at full Momentum cannot be dodged. A killing blow refunds all Momentum. Momentum persists through Tumble.

talents.name: Fleet Footed
talents.text: Momentum grants movement speed while it lasts, and snares are shortened per stack held. At full Momentum you cannot be rooted.

talents.name: Deft Hands
talents.text: Your attack speed scales with Momentum held. The scaling persists 4 sec after Momentum ends. Momentum is not lost on a miss. Two strikes in a row build double. At full Momentum your off-hand strikes with the main.

talents.name: Tumble
talents.text: A short directional roll. Not a Sprint. The thing that makes the fantasy read as flow instead of speed.

talents.name: Open Hand
talents.text: Your unarmed attacks use your Fist Weapon skill. They scale as a weapon.

talents.name: Lithe
talents.text: Tumble builds Momentum rather than spending it. It may be used while rooted. It refreshes Momentum's duration.

talents.name: Sinew
talents.text: Your critical strike chance scales with Momentum held, and criticals build an extra stack. Momentum is not lost when you change target. Spending Momentum refreshes your poisons. At full Momentum criticals cannot be resisted.

talents.name: Momentum
talents.text: Moving in combat builds Momentum. Each stack drives your strikes harder. Momentum holds three stacks. The cap rises to five. Standing still sheds it one stack at a time instead of all at once.

talents.name: No Opening Needed
talents.text: Your openers no longer require stealth, though they strike softer used openly. At full rank they strike as though you had never been seen.

talents.name: Redirection
talents.text: Changing targets no longer clears combo points. Combo points persist 10 sec out of combat. A killing blow transfers them to your next target.

talents.name: Sweeping Kick
talents.text: A combo point spender that briefly stuns all enemies within melee range. Rogue's first multi-target control.

talents.name: Blade Harmony
talents.text: Attacking a target you have not hit in the last 6 sec grants Momentum. The bonus doubles against a target no ally has struck. It cannot be dodged.

talents.name: Precision Footwork
talents.text: Your strikes cannot miss while Momentum is at full stacks. A miss builds Momentum instead. Momentum spent on a miss is refunded.

talents.name: Second Wind
talents.text: Being stunned or rooted builds Momentum. The effect breaks the control once every 30 sec.

talents.name: Whirling Blades
talents.text: A finisher dealing damage to multiple enemies, scaling with combo points.

talents.name: Unbroken Rhythm
talents.text: Whirling Blades spends Momentum for damage rather than energy. It refreshes Momentum on a killing blow. It may be used while moving.

talents.name: Evasive
talents.text: Momentum stacks grant dodge. Dodging builds a stack rather than spending one.

talents.name: Perpetual Motion
talents.text: Momentum never decays and starts at full. You may no longer use any ability that costs energy.

talents.name: Edged Discipline
talents.text: Whirling Blades may be used at range with a bladed weapon. It returns to you, striking again. It cannot be resisted on the return.

talents.name: Flowing Palm
talents.text: With a fist weapon or bare hands, Whirling Blades refunds a combo point for every four targets struck. The refund comes every three targets. It comes every two.

talents.name: Relentless
talents.text: Whirling Blades refunds a combo point per target struck. The refund is not capped by your maximum. A full refund makes your next finisher free.

talents.name: Uninterrupted
talents.text: Momentum stacks decay two at a time rather than clearing. The decay slows to one stack at a time.

talents.name: Killing Flow
talents.text: Killing an enemy grants two Momentum stacks. It refreshes Momentum's duration. A killing blow at full Momentum grants a free ability.

talents.name: Unending Dance
talents.text: Momentum behaves differently by weapon. Your whirling Blades no longer costs a full finisher below three targets. Every fourth strike you land sweeps through a second enemy.

mechanic.name: Empowerment
mechanic.description: Empowerment, where certain spells may be held while casting to advance through charge stages

lore.verbNote: The elements agree or they do not, so the chain is a petition rather than a conquest. It should be possible to be refused and have to return.
lore.loreAnchor: Dragonflight-era Evoker lore does not exist in a Classic timeframe and should not be imported. The shaman's existing relationship with the elements carries the whole tree.

talents.name: Elemental Focus
talents.text: Casting Lightning Bolt may leave you Clearcast, halving the cost of your next spell. Casting any elemental spell may trigger it. The next spell instead costs nothing. Clearcasting also reduces the next spell's pushback. The pushback is removed entirely.

talents.name: Steady Channel
talents.text: Empowering cannot be pushed back. Damage taken while empowering adds a stage instead. An interrupted empowerment releases at its current stage rather than failing.

talents.name: Elemental Warding
talents.text: Fire, Frost, and Nature damage taken adds an empowerment stage. The stage cannot be resisted. Absorbing such damage grants a free cast. Empowerment on you converts magic damage to healing once per fight. At full empowerment you cannot be interrupted.

talents.name: Empowered Lightning
talents.text: Your Lightning Bolt may be held to charge through three stages.

talents.name: Grounding
talents.text: Empowered spells cost health instead of mana above half health. You enter combat with a charge already held, and for the first 20 sec your spells empower faster and hit harder.

talents.name: Tidal Focus
talents.text: Your heals cannot be overhealed on a target below 30% health. Overhealing becomes an absorb. The absorb persists 10 sec.

talents.name: Ancestral Insight
talents.text: Your spell damage and healing scale with empowerment stages held. Stages persist through a target change. Releasing early keeps the scaling for 6 sec. Two empowerments in a row grant a free stage. At full stages your next cast is instant.

talents.name: Living Current
talents.text: Empowered Lightning Bolt at full charge restores mana. Any empowered spell at full charge restores mana. At full charge the surplus discharges as damage. A bonded ally gains half the mana restored. The bonded ally gains the full amount.

talents.name: Empowered Healing
talents.text: Your Healing Wave may be held to charge, and each stage raises its effect and its radius. At full charge it cannot be overhealed.

talents.name: Storm Reach
talents.text: Your spells reach further. At maximum range they ignore line of sight. Range no longer reduces their effect.

talents.name: Totemic Reach
talents.text: Your totems reach twice as far and follow you between them. A totem out of range still counts as placed.

talents.name: Elemental Grace
talents.text: Empowerment reaches full charge faster. Movement no longer slows the charge. Releasing early keeps one stage.

talents.name: Restorative Current
talents.text: Empowered Healing at full charge heals a second ally. The second heal cannot overheal. It carries the first heal's element.

talents.name: Earthen Footing
talents.text: You cannot be interrupted while casting. Being struck while casting shortens your next cast instead.

talents.name: Elemental Bond
talents.text: Places one active totem's effect on a single ally rather than on the ground. The effect follows them and persists while they remain in your party.

talents.name: Elemental Devotion
talents.text: Elemental Bond does not expire while you are empowering. It transfers to a second ally at half effect. Breaking it releases its remaining duration as healing.

talents.name: Surge
talents.text: Empowered spells at full charge may release without consuming their charge. A held charge released early deals its accumulated value at once.

talents.name: Unbroken Current
talents.text: Your empowered casts cannot be interrupted or pushed back. You may no longer cast anything instantly.

talents.name: Conductive
talents.text: Empowered spells at full charge strike a second target. The second strike carries the full element. It cannot be resisted.

talents.name: Deep Bond
talents.text: Elemental Bond binds harder and to a second ally. The bond does not break when either of you dies.

talents.name: Wellspring
talents.text: Living Current restores mana to bonded allies. The restoration scales with charge held. A bonded ally at full mana gains an absorb instead.

talents.name: Confluence
talents.text: Your elemental Bond may be active on up to three allies at once, and fully empowered spells grant a brief share of their effect to everyone you are bonded to.

mechanic.name: Charge
mechanic.description: Rune charges accumulated on the weapon and spent on effects. The magic belongs to the object throughout.

lore.verbNote: An object, not a power, which is the whole reason warrior can have it without becoming a spellcaster. The chain produces a weapon and requires someone who can make one.
lore.loreAnchor: Runeblades are forged objects in Warcraft lore, so a warrior who carries one has acquired an item rather than a power. Warrior's identity in vanilla is defined negatively, as the class with no magic, and this respects that.

talents.name: Cold Iron
talents.text: Your weapon holds its charge between fights. You enter combat with one charge already held. You enter combat with two charges already held. You enter combat fully charged. For the first 20 sec your weapon strikes deal increased damage.

talents.name: Frostbitten
talents.text: Frost damage taken is reduced. Absorbing Frost damage heals you. At full absorption you are immune to Frost for 4 sec.

talents.name: Iron Discipline
talents.text: Your strikes cannot miss while the weapon holds charges. A miss grants a Charge instead. Charges are not spent on a dodge or parry. Two strikes in a row grant an extra Charge. At full charges your strikes cannot be avoided.

talents.name: Rime
talents.text: Your melee strikes may chill what they touch, and the chill deepens on a critical. A chilled target cannot outrun you.

talents.name: Weighted Edge
talents.text: Slowed targets grant an extra Charge when struck. Charges spent on a slowed target deal double. Slowing a target refreshes the weapon's charges.

talents.name: Glacial Edge
talents.text: Rime does not expire while the weapon holds charges. Rime spends a Charge to refresh itself. A Charge spent under Rime applies a slow.

talents.name: Tempered
talents.text: Your weapon damage scales with charges held. The scaling persists 6 sec after spending. Charges are not lost on death. Spending all charges at once doubles the effect. At full charges your weapon strikes a second target.

talents.name: Rune Charge
talents.text: One charge held on your weapon adds frost damage to every swing. A second charge adds its frost damage. A third charge adds its frost damage. Every charge held adds its frost damage. The charges do not bleed away between fights.

talents.name: Cold Endurance
talents.text: Below 35% health you take reduced damage. Damage absorbed this way heals you for a portion.

talents.name: Cold Blood
talents.text: Your next strike is a guaranteed critical. Used on a finisher it adds two combo points to those spent. The finisher doubles the combo points spent instead.

talents.name: Shattering Blow
talents.text: Consumes all rune charges to deal frost damage scaled to the number consumed.

talents.name: Killing Frost
talents.text: Critical strikes against slowed targets restore rune charges. A killing blow restores all charges. Charges restored this way do not decay.

talents.name: Chillguard
talents.text: Slowed enemies deal reduced damage to you. Their attacks cannot be critical. A slowed attacker is briefly rooted after striking you.

talents.name: Frost Reserve
talents.text: Rune charges build faster and build while sheathed. Two charges may be banked beyond the maximum.

talents.name: Hoarfrost
talents.text: For 20 sec every swing deals additional frost damage and applies Rime automatically. 2 min cooldown.

talents.name: Numbing Cold
talents.text: Rime reduces the target's attack speed. It cannot be dispelled. It spreads to a nearby enemy on death.

talents.name: Deep Freeze
talents.text: Shattering Blow spends every Charge held and scales with the number spent. It applies Rime for each Charge spent.

talents.name: Bound Blade
talents.text: Your weapon holds twice as many charges. It never loses them, and you may no longer change weapons.

talents.name: Permafrost
talents.text: Rune charges no longer decay out of combat. They persist through death. They are not lost on a weapon swap.

talents.name: Bitter Cold
talents.text: Shattering Blow chills everything nearby. While your weapon holds charges every fifth strike you land sweeps through a second enemy beside your target.

talents.name: Unbreakable Rime
talents.text: Rime cannot be dispelled. Its slow is not reduced by the target's effects. It refreshes when you spend a Charge.

talents.name: The Runeblade
talents.text: Requires an equipped runeblade. Your weapon permanently deals frost damage on every swing, your strikes always apply Rime, and killing blows restore rage.

mechanic.name: Trap
mechanic.description: Traps used offensively rather than defensively

lore.verbNote: A master, a trial, and a demonstration. The Beastmaster was a hero you hired rather than one you built.
lore.loreAnchor: Rexxar exists in Warcraft III and in vanilla, fights in melee alongside Misha, and is the archetype fully realized. A hunter tree that produces Rexxar is a tree that produces something the setting already contains.

talents.name: Savage Strikes
talents.text: Your melee strikes arm your nearest trap. Traps armed this way trigger without being stepped on. A strike at a trapped target triggers it immediately. Killing a trapped target rearms the trap. At full traps your strikes cannot be dodged.

talents.name: Trap Mastery
talents.text: Traps deal damage instead of only controlling. They apply Serpent Sting. Explosive Trap knocks back.

talents.name: Hunter's Guile
talents.text: Your traps scale with your ranged attack power. Traps cannot be resisted. They arm instantly. Two may be active at once. A trap that is broken early refunds its cooldown.

talents.name: Combat Trapping
talents.text: Your traps may be laid in combat and laying one costs no global cooldown. A trap laid before the pull arms at full strength, and for the first 20 sec of an encounter your traps and strikes deal increased damage.

talents.name: Deflection
talents.text: Parrying an attack grants you a short damage reduction. Parrying also refreshes Deterrence.

talents.name: Improved Traps
talents.text: Trap cooldowns are shared rather than separate. Triggering one resets another. Traps may be laid in combat.

talents.name: Thick Hide
talents.text: Armor from items is increased. Damage taken is reduced while standing still. Below 35% health you cannot be critically struck. Absorbed damage heals you. A killing blow grants a short damage reduction.

talents.name: Close Quarters
talents.text: Your ranged shots do not suffer at melee range. Raptor Strike does not consume your ranged swing. Melee strikes refresh Serpent Sting. A melee critical grants focus. At melee range you cannot be disarmed.

talents.name: Snare Expert
talents.text: Traps arm faster and their snare cannot be dispelled. A snared target draws nearby enemies toward the trap.

talents.name: Surefooted
talents.text: You cannot be slowed below base speed. Snares on you are shortened. Movement-impairing effects cannot be reapplied for 4 sec.

talents.name: Harpoon
talents.text: Throw a line to an enemy within 25 yd and pull yourself to them. A melee hunter without a gap closer is not a melee hunter.

talents.name: Wyvern Venom
talents.text: Melee strikes against trapped targets apply a lingering poison. The poison prevents the target regaining health. It spreads when the trap is triggered again.

talents.name: Killer Instinct
talents.text: Critical strikes arm a trap. A trap triggered by a critical deals double damage. Traps benefit from your critical strike chance.

talents.name: Entrapment
talents.text: Your traps root what they catch and the root holds longer. The root cannot be broken by your own damage.

talents.name: Coordinated Assault
talents.text: Your melee strikes command your pet to strike the same target for bonus damage. Off the global cooldown.

talents.name: Resourcefulness
talents.text: Melee abilities cost no mana while a trap of yours is armed. Using one arms a trap. Below 30% mana traps arm themselves.

talents.name: Bestial Discipline
talents.text: Your pet arms traps it walks over. Your pet cannot trigger your own traps.

talents.name: Sole Survivor
talents.text: Your traps arm instantly and cannot be resisted. You may no longer have a pet active.

talents.name: Pack Instinct
talents.text: Your pet gains a share of your attack power. It also gains your critical strike chance. It cannot be slowed while a trap of yours is armed.

talents.name: Trapper's Cunning
talents.text: Traps rearm themselves once after triggering. A rearmed trap costs no cooldown.

talents.name: Ferocious Bond
talents.text: Coordinated Assault heals your pet. It also removes one harmful effect from it. Your pet cannot die while it is active.

talents.name: Hunt as One
talents.text: You and your pet share a single threat pool and a single target. Your coordinated Assault triggers automatically on every third melee strike, and your pet's abilities are usable off your own cooldowns.

renamed.why: Hunter carried two trees named Survival, the vanilla rebuild and this absorbed tree. The absorbed tree is renamed for its concept: the close-range trapper whose mechanic is the Trap.

mechanic.name: Echo
mechanic.description: Echo, a recorded snapshot of an ally's health taken by your spells and spent to return them to it. Not a resource bar; it lives on the target.

lore.verbNote: The seventh verb, and the only one that is not an event. Anachronos does not teach the chain, he shows it. The quest Long Forgotten Memories already has a mortal look into a Crystalline Tear and watch something that already happened; the acquisition is recognising that one of those memories is yours.
lore.permanentCost: Cannot be resurrected by another player. Returns unaided after a delay, at a position held earlier in the fight.
lore.loreAnchor: Anachronos has stood at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris since patch 1.9, gating access behind Brood of Nozdormu reputation and showing chosen mortals the sealing of Ahn'Qiraj through a Crystalline Tear in Silithus. Vanilla already contains a bronze dragon whose entire function is letting a mortal witness what already happened. Nothing needs inventing.

talents.name: Recollection
talents.text: Your spells record an Echo of an ally's health. Echoes persist through your own death. An Echo taken above 90% health is worth more. Two Echoes may be held per ally. Echoes do not expire while you remain in combat.

talents.name: Borrowed Time
talents.text: Your heals may be cast before they are needed, landing 3 sec later. The delay may be cancelled. A delayed heal landing on a full ally becomes an absorb. Two may be in flight. A delayed heal whose target dies first returns to you as mana.

talents.name: Accelerate
talents.text: Spending an Echo hastens the ally's next action. Their attack speed. Shortens their next cooldown. Extends to anyone else you Echoed recently. Shortens their global cooldown once.

talents.name: Sand in the Glass
talents.text: Time spent not casting banks mana. The bank may be spent as a burst. It may be shared with an ally you Echoed. It is not lost on taking damage.

talents.name: Dilation
talents.text: Blink leaves an Echo of your position. Returning to it restores the mana you held. The health, and an ally may trigger the return.

talents.name: Temporal Anomaly
talents.text: Place a stationary field in which healing over time ticks at twice the rate.

talents.name: Regression
talents.text: Spending an Echo also removes one recently applied debuff. Returns the ally's threat to its recorded value. Restores mana as well as health. Doubles below 20% health. Is not consumed if the ally already sits at the Echo's value.

talents.name: Foresight
talents.text: You see damage already in flight. A shield cast on an ally with incoming damage absorbs more. The shield's unspent remainder becomes an Echo.

talents.name: Stasis
talents.text: Suspend an ally in time. They take no damage, cannot act, and cannot be healed. Ends on command.

talents.name: Paradox
